mentions.name: Pump.Fun/Solana trading bot
mentions.description: This is an automated trading bot for Pump.Fun/Solana that targets ultra-low-quality meme coins, built around an identified edge that exploits Pump's bonding curve. The author previously profited using the strategy through manual trading and is now automating it. The project also serves as a hands-on example for learning spec-driven development, iterating the spec in Claude Code with adversarial models.
mentions.problem: The profitable bonding-curve strategy has so far only been executed manually and the author wants to automate it; the current development challenge is that the spec has ballooned to 2.5k lines and is hard to split up for coding/implementation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a Pump.Fun/Solana trading bot for ultra-shit coins... because I have identified a edge that lets me exploit the 'bonding curve' in Pump. I've "won" using this strategy manually, now I want to automate it.
mentions.author: iafiaf
